name: Karonga ERA5 Climate Exposure Dataset
description: ERA5 climate variables for Karonga HDSS, Malawi, used to derive flood and heat exposure indicators for OMOP EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE.

variableMeasured.name: 2m_temperature
variableMeasured.description: Temperature exposure used for heat-stress and climate-health analysis.

variableMeasured.name: 2m_dewpoint_temperature
variableMeasured.description: Used with temperature to derive humidity-related exposure indicators.

variableMeasured.name: total_precipitation
variableMeasured.description: Used to derive rainfall totals, flood occurrence, intensity, and duration.

variableMeasured.name: 10m_u_component_of_wind
variableMeasured.description: Used with v-component wind to derive wind speed.

variableMeasured.name: 10m_v_component_of_wind
variableMeasured.description: Used with u-component wind to derive wind speed.

measurementTechnique: Hourly ERA5 data retrieved through the Copernicus Climate Data Store API and aggregated into daily and monthly exposure indicators.
